# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We aim to make CopyDogg a welcoming open-source project for contributors of all experience levels, whether this is your first pull request or your five-hundredth.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Keep feedback focused on the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming.
- Help newcomers find their way around the project.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults or abusive language
- Discrimination of any kind
- Publishing anyone's private data, including posts or voice profiles from someone's CopyDogg data file
- Sharing secrets or credentials, such as API keys or `.env.local` contents

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close issues and pull requests, or block contributors who violate this code of conduct.

To report a problem privately, contact the maintainer through [@dhrma-tech](https://github.com/dhrma-tech) on GitHub.
